title: Naturally Malty Korean Eggplant Yakimono
description: A malty, juicy, and flavorful Korean dish featuring Thai eggplant and a rustic, easy-to-make yakimono-grill. This dish is suitable for a lazy Sunday afternoon meal.
instructions: Trim the stems of the Thai eggplants and cut them into 1-inch pieces. Rinse them under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together the brown rice vinegar, gochujang, gochugaru, sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, green onions, toasted sesame seeds, black pepper, and salt.
Add the eggplant pieces to the bowl and toss them to coat evenly with the marinade.
Heat a yakimono-grill or a charcoal grill to medium-high heat. If using a yakimono-grill, oil the grates with a paper towel dipped in oil.
Add the eggplant pieces to the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Transfer the eggplant pieces to a serving platter and brush them with the remaining marinade.
Serve the eggplant yakimono hot, garnished with additional green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
